req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-038 requires that Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* is present on ALL responses. To achieve high mutation kill rate we must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence; (2) cover multiple endpoints to confirm the header is universal; (3) test that the header is absent when the CORS middleware is bypassed (negative path); (4) test boundary endpoints like /status/200 and /status/400 to confirm the header appears on non-2xx responses too; (5) test that the header value is exactly '*' and not some other wildcard or origin. We use Flask test_client() in-process, never a live URL.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers
    assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint()

tests.name: test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial_wildcard
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert header value is exactly '*' not 'null', not empty, not a specific origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial_wildcard():
    r = client.get('/headers')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != ''
    assert val != 'null'
    assert val != 'http://example.com'

test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial_wildcard()

tests.name: test_cors_header_missing_would_fail
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify that a missing or wrong CORS header value would be caught
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: negative path — absence of header is a failure
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_missing_would_fail():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    cors = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert cors is not None, 'CORS header must not be absent'
    assert cors != '', 'CORS header must not be empty'
    assert cors != 'null', 'CORS header must not be null'
    assert cors == '*', f'Expected *, got {cors!r}'

test_cors_header_missing_would_fail()

tests.name: test_cors_header_on_basic_auth_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: header on successful auth response
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_on_basic_auth_200():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    cors = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert cors is not None
    assert cors == '*'

test_cors_header_on_basic_auth_200()
